title: BOOK DESCRIPTION
paragraphs: Your greatest spiritual battle may not be happening around you.
It may be happening inside your mind.
Every day believers face a flood of thoughts—fear, temptation, shame, doubt, and condemnation. Many Christians assume these thoughts are simply part of their personality.
But Scripture reveals a deeper reality.
There is a battle for your mind.
In The Battle for Your Mind, you will learn:

• how the enemy plants deceptive thoughts
• how mental strongholds develop
• how to recognize toxic thinking patterns
• how to take thoughts captive to Christ
• how to renew your mind through Scripture
This book will equip you with biblical tools to break cycles of destructive thinking and walk in the freedom that comes from truth.
Inside the library you will find:

• powerful short Christian books
• spiritual warfare teaching
• repentance and freedom resources
• discipleship tools for renewing the mind
